data.title: 菲亚梅塔 · 露台的晚风
data.description: 风凉起来，她伸手拉住你，带你站到挡风的一侧。等你靠近，她才松开手，低声问要不要多待一会儿。
data.action: 倚栏回眸，轻轻握住镜头前的手
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Under a vast, clear night sky on an elegant terrace railing, Fiammetta turns back to reach for the viewer's hand with a soft, gentle smile that lightens her usually stern demeanor. The distant, sprawling city lights below create a mesmerizing bokeh effect, while cool, nocturnal air rustles her plumage, enhancing the intimate, peaceful connection.
data.animaCaption: Leaning lightly against a night terrace railing, she glances back over her shoulder with a soft smile and reaches out to take the viewer's hand. Cool evening air drifts past while sprawling city lights blur into bokeh below.
